from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    p = [0] * (n + 1)
    s = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        s += x
        p[i + 1] = s

    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_num = -1
    best_den = 1

    for r in range(k, n + 1):
        l = r - k
        pl = p[l]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            x1 = hull[-2]
            x2 = hull[-1]
            y1 = p[x1]
            y2 = p[x2]
            if (y2 - y1) * (l - x2) >= (pl - y2) * (x2 - x1):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(l)

        pr = p[r]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            x1 = hull[head]
            x2 = hull[head + 1]
            if (pr - p[x1]) * (r - x2) <= (pr - p[x2]) * (r - x1):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        x1 = hull[head]
        num = pr - p[x1]
        den = r - x1
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
